extracted.name: Mom's Famous Raw Vegetable Dip
extracted.description: This vegetable dip is made with sour cream, mayonnaise, onion, parsley, and dill for a quick and tasty homemade easy appetizer in just 10 minutes.
instruction_lines: Mix together sour cream, mayonnaise, onion, parsley, dill, and seasoned salt in a serving bowl until well combined. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
